title: HED unit plurals
description: Machine-readable form of the plurals of unit names, HED specification section 3.1.4.4 (Unit classes and units). The table of plurals in Appendix A.1.1 (docs/source/Appendix_A.md) is generated from this file by scripts/generate_unit_plural_table.py. Validators load this file unchanged; no plural is derived by a rule or by a pluralize function. Each key of plurals is a unit name of a released HED schema and its value is the one plural of that name, both case-sensitive. A unit name that is not a key has no plural, and a unit symbol is never a key. A name whose value is the name itself is its own plural. The plural of a unit name with an SI unit modifier is the modifier followed by the listed plural.
